title: Create a Lead Generation ad with optimization location as instant messaging apps
content_data:
This article introduces how to create a Lead Generation ad with optimization location as instant messaging apps. This enables the ad audience to take two different actions based on their App installation status by clicking the call-to-action button within the ad: - If the audience has installed the instant messaging app (such as WhatsApp), they can send a message to you (advertiser) on the App. - If the audience hasn't installed the instant messaging app, they will be directed to view a Custom TikTok Instant Page. > **Note**
>
  • Creating a Lead Generation ad with optimization location as instant messaging apps is generally available for advertisers registered in the following APAC regions: Australia, Bangladesh, Cambodia, Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, New Zealand, Pakistan, the Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Sri Lanka, Taiwan, Thailand, and Vietnam.
  • For advertisers registered in other regions, this feature is currently an allowlist-only feature. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative.
# Prerequisite - We recommend connecting to one of our integrated [Message Management Tools](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/about-message-management-tools) (MMTs) before setting up your campaign to allow for deeper optimization goals and better performance. - If you've already integrated with an MMT and are optimizing for Conversations, make sure to set up the TikTok integration on your MMT before selecting Conversations and choosing your messaging event. - If you are using WhatsApp, you will need to use a unique phone number for the WhatsApp Business API that is not used in any other WhatsApp personal or business accounts. You can sign up for the WhatsApp Business API directly on your MMT. - Some MMTs, such as Pancake, may require you to add to your wallet before you can reply to customer messages. Additional charges for using the WhatsApp Business API will be collected by your MMT and passed back to Meta. # Steps ## 1. Create a campaign Create a campaign using [/campaign/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739318962329602). Note that the following requirements must be met. ```xtable | Setting {20%} | Requirement {30%} | Parameter {20%} | How to configure the parameter {30%} | |---|---|---|---| | Advertising objective | Lead Generation | `objective_type` | `LEAD_GENERATION` | | Smart+ Campaign| Disabled

If you are not sure about whether the campaign is Smart+ Campaign, you can use the `is_smart_performance_campaign` field returned from [/campaign/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1739315828649986) to check. | / | / | ``` ### Example Request ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/campaign/create/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "objective_type": "LEAD_GENERATION", "campaign_name": "{{campaign_name}}", "budget_mode": "BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL", "budget": {{budget}} }' (/code) ``` Response ```xcodeblock (code curl http) { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "campaign_name": "{{campaign_name}}", "modify_time": "{{modify_time}}", "objective": "LANDING_PAGE", "roas_bid": 0, "budget": {{budget}}, "secondary_status": "CAMPAIGN_STATUS_ENABLE", "is_smart_performance_campaign": false, "create_time": "{{create_time}}", "deep_bid_type": null, "campaign_type": "REGULAR_CAMPAIGN", "is_new_structure": true, "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "budget_mode": "BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL", "objective_type": "LEAD_GENERATION", "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "operation_status": "ENABLE" } } (/code) ``` ## 2. Create an ad group Create an ad group using [/adgroup/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739499616346114). Note that the following requirements must be met.
Setting Requirement Parameter How to configure the parameter
Optimization location
(Promotion type)		 Instant messaging apps promotion_type LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_SOCIAL_MEDIA_APP_MESSAGE
promotion_target_type Not passed
Select your Instant messaging app or use a customized URL
 Any of the following options:
  • Messenger with Facebook Page ID
  • WhatsApp with WhatsApp phone number
  • Zalo with Zalo phone number
  • LINE with LINE Business ID
  • Instant Messaging URL
 messaging_app_type
messaging_app_account_id
phone_region_code
phone_region_calling_code
phone_number
  • To use the Instant messaging app Messenger:
    • Set messaging_app_type to MESSENGER and specify a Facebook Page ID via messaging_app_account_id.
      • To find your Facebook Page ID, go to your Facebook Page and click About below your cover photo, then click Page transparency.
    • Do not pass phone_region_code, phone_region_calling_code, and phone_number.
  • To use the Instant messaging app WhatsApp:
    • Set messaging_app_type to WHATSAPP and pass phone_region_code, phone_region_calling_code, and phone_number.
    • Do not pass messaging_app_account_id. Your setting will be ignored and this field will be set as the corresponding WhatsApp phone number automatically populated based on the specified phone_region_code, phone_region_calling_code, and phone_number.
  • To use the Instant messaging app Zalo:
    • Set messaging_app_type to ZALO and pass phone_region_code, phone_region_calling_code, and phone_number.
    • Do not pass messaging_app_account_id.
  • To use the Instant messaging app LINE:
    • Set messaging_app_type to LINE and specify a LINE Business ID via messaging_app_account_id.
      • To find your LINE Business ID, go to your LINE official account page.
    • Do not pass phone_region_code, phone_region_calling_code, or phone_number.
  • To use Instant Messaging URL:
    • Set messaging_app_type to IM_URL.
    • Do not pass messaging_app_account_id, phone_region_code, phone_region_calling_code, and phone_number.
Placement Select Placement with TikTok placement placement_type PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL
placements ["PLACEMENT_TIKTOK"]

Include search results		 Not supported search_result_enabled false or not passed
Age targeting Audiences younger than 18 years old can't be targeted. age_groups Do not pass the value AGE_13_17.
Demographics - Location targeting The available targeting regions are as follows:
  • APAC: Australia, Cambodia, Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Thailand, Vietnam
  • LATAM: Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Mexico, Peru

Note that advertisers registered with the Chinese mainland (CN) cannot target locations in Australia and Indonesia.		 location_ids Pass the IDs of locations within the following regions:
  • APAC: Australia, Cambodia, Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Thailand, Vietnam
  • LATAM: Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Mexico, Peru

Note that advertisers registered with the Chinese mainland (CN) cannot target locations in Australia and Indonesia.

To obtain the available targeting locations, use /tool/targeting/search/ or /tool/region/.
Pangle audience packages Not supported included_pangle_audience_package_ids
excluded_pangle_audience_package_ids		 Not supported
Optimization goal
Any of the following types:
  • Click
  • Conversations (supported with allowlist)

Note: If you have selected Zalo, LINE, or Instant Messaging URL, you can only use the optimization goal Click.

 optimization_goal Any of the following values:
  • CLICK
  • CONVERSATION

Note:

  • When messaging_app_type is ZALO, LINE, or IM_URL, you can only set optimization_goal to CLICK.
  • The optimization goal Conversation (CONVERSATION) is currently an allowlist-only feature. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative
optimization_event
  • If optimization_goal is CLICK, do not pass optimization_event.
  • If optimization_goal is CONVERSATION, omit optimization_event or set optimization_event to MESSAGE.
Message event set Specify a valid message event set when the following conditions are met:
  • Optimization goal is set to Conversations.
  • The messaging app account in your ad group settings doesn't match any existing message event set.

If the messaging app account in your ad group settings matches a unique existing message event set, the unique message event set associated with the instant messaging app account you choose will be automatically selected.		 message_event_set_id Specify a valid value when the following conditions are met:
  • optimization_goal is CONVERSATION.
  • The messaging app account in your ad group settings doesn't match any existing message event set.

  • If the messaging app account, either the Messenger account specified via messaging_app_account_id or the WhatsApp account matched from the specified phone_region_code, phone_region_calling_code, and phone_number, in your ad group settings matches an existing event set, this field will be ignored and automatically populated with the unique message event set associated with the instant messaging app account you choose.
    • To confirm whether a unique message event set is associated with the instant messaging app account you choose, use /ctm/message_event_set/get/ and check the returned matched_event_set.
  • If the instant messaging app account in your ad group settings doesn't match any existing message event set (matched_event_set returned from /ctm/message_event_set/get/ is empty), use /ctm/message_event_set/get/ to obtain the message event sets available for ad creation via the response parameter message_event_set_list.
Bid Strategy Any of the following types:
  • Maximum Delivery
  • Cost Cap (or Target CPA)
 bid_type
bid_price
conversion_bid_price		 Any of the following values for bid_type:
  • BID_TYPE_NO_BID
  • BID_TYPE_CUSTOM
    • If bid_type is BID_TYPE_CUSTOM and optimization_goal is CONVERSATION, pass conversion_bid_price at the same time.
    • If bid_type is BID_TYPE_CUSTOM and optimization_goal is CLICK, pass bid_price at the same time.
Billing event
  • If optimization goal is Click, the billing event should be CPC.
  • If optimization goal is Conversations, the billing event should be oCPM.
 billing_event
  • If optimization_goal is CLICK, set this field to CPC.
  • If optimization_goal is CONVERSATION, set this field to OCPM.
Delivery Type
  • If Bid Strategy is Maximum Delivery, you can only set Delivery Type to Standard.
  • If Bid Strategy is Cost Cap, you can set Delivery Type to Standard or Accelerated.
 pacing
  • If bid_type is BID_TYPE_NO_BID, you can only set pacing to PACING_MODE_SMOOTH.
  • If bid_type is BID_TYPE_CUSTOM, you can set pacing to PACING_MODE_SMOOTH or PACING_MODE_FAST.
Automated Creative Optimization (ACO) Not supported creative_material_mode CUSTOM or not passed

(CLICK)		 Instant messaging apps Manually specify the Instant messaging URL and do not pass page_id.

  • To specify the Instant messaging URL as Apple’s universal link or Android App Link:
    • Set landing_page_url to a link starting with http:// or https://.
    • Do not pass deeplink, deeplink_type, and fallback_type.
  • To specify the Instant messaging URL as a Custom URL scheme of an Instant messaging app:
    • Set deeplink to a link in the format of scheme://resource. For instance, a Custom URL scheme of WhatsApp should follow the format whatsapp://resource.
    • Set deeplink_type to NORMAL or do not pass deeplink_type.
    • Set fallback_type to WEBSITE.
    • Set landing_page_url to a fallback URL, in the format of Apple’s universal link or Android App Link starting with http:// or https://.
